description: MCP server for Google Search Console: 17 read-only tools covering performance queries, quick wins, CTR gaps, cannibalisation, traffic-drop diagnosis and indexing, plus a self-contained white-label HTML SEO audit in English or Italian. Claude Code plugin, .mcpb bundle, Docker.

tool_signatures.name: gsc_audit
tool_signatures.description: Build a complete, self-contained HTML SEO audit for one property.

brand_terms.description: Words that mark a query as branded. Without them the first label of the domain is used, which is often wrong.

output.description: `file` writes the report and returns its path, `inline` returns the HTML as an embedded resource, `both` does both, `auto` picks by transport.

output_dir.description: Where to write the report. Defaults to ~/gsc-reports/.

branding_path.description: Path to a branding.json overriding colours, logo, name and thresholds.

inspect_top_pages.description: How many top pages to run through URL Inspection. 0 disables it.

thresholds.description: Override the adaptive thresholds: min_impressions, min_clicks, high_visibility_impressions, ctr_curve.
